description: On the tabletop, there’s a white lamp-like stand with a round bulb in the center and a white cup-shaped piece to the right. The left hand rests on the table near the stand while the right hand reaches in from the right, grasps the cup-shaped piece as a right-hand object, lifts it up and moves it leftward over the stand, then lowers it to fit down onto the bulb/upper part of the stand.
